body: I thought it was going to be cool but unfortunately it gave me the completely wrong recipe and ruined my meal.

title: Shopping list doesnt work
body: For example if your recipe calls for 2 cups of chicken and you add it to a list it will simply say 2 chicken. I dont have time to go back through and add a measurement to every single ingredient- that is why im using an app.

title: Seriously?
body: Won’t let me enter fractional units, ‘each’ units, and the AI hangs trying to generate a simple pesto recipe.

title: So Bummed
body: I wasn’t aware that there was a free version recipe limit. I even searched in the app advertisement to see if I could find something, and I don’t see any mention of this. When you have met or exceeded the free app limits, you aren’t permitted to ask Lyle anything anymore, therefore you cannot modify your current recipes if you locate an error. The edit icon also doesn’t work to modify existing recipes. I cannot ask AI to propose a recipe should I decide to delete a recipe. I’ve deleted several in the hopes that I could open up my options, but sadly I’m unable to. It seems I’m locked into where I am now which will have me looking for a new app to use. I understand that there will be new developments, however, I do feel that there should be some dedication to the users and the functionality that they have become accustomed instead of rendering those unusable in order to sign the user to the advanced application.

title: Flawed
body: I thought my spouse and I were crazy, but we see now this app is severely flawed when entering our meals into the planner. Everything is off by a day. And the recipe AI is so unreliable creating more work. Currently deleted and searching for something better.

title: Not impressed so far
body: I just downloaded the app spent 20 min adding ingredients from my pantry. I tried to have it make recipe and it just kept spinning, didn’t come up with any results. Then I went back to my ingredients list to add a couple things I hit the clear button by accident and everything I entered was gone without a warning. Seems like it only can handle a few ingredients not everything you actually keep on hand

title: Very easy. And fun!
body: Recipe sites always drag on and on before they give you the instructions. But this app gets straight to the point. And it does it smoothly and cleanly. And it’s kind of fun (love the robot chef helper!). There’s a VERY quick interview to get to started and that was fun too. I always end up cooking the same things over and over. But this has made it easy to add real options to my repertoire. Try it!

title: Great recipe keeper
body: This is a really good app to store recipes. The recipes it comes up with are good and easy to follow. I’m not a great cook and I can use it easily. It has a lot of features that make me more excited to use it and experiment in cooking.

title: Great recipe app!
body: So many clever features for generating recipes and meal planning. Well worth the monthly sub.

title: So Helpful
body: This app is amazing!! I wish I had it 5 years ago!!

title: Game changer for dinners

title: Whisk
body: As an avid home cook, I've explored countless cooking apps, but none have matched the excellence of Whisk. This app is a culinary delight, offering a seamless blend of innovative features, user-friendly interface, and a treasure trove of recipes that cater to every palate. From novice chefs to seasoned pros, Whisk caters to all skill levels with its intuitive design. The app's layout is clean and easy to navigate, ensuring that even beginners can find their way around effortlessly. The recipe search function is a gem, allowing users to filter by cuisine, dietary restrictions, cooking time, and more, making meal planning a breeze. What truly sets Whisk apart is its extensive library of recipes. Whether you're craving Italian pasta, Asian stir-fry, or a decadent dessert, this app has you covered. Each recipe is meticulously curated, with clear instructions, ingredient lists, and stunning visuals that inspire culinary creativity. But the real magic happens with the interactive features. Whisk offers step-by-step video tutorials for select recipes, allowing users to follow along with ease. The built-in timer ensures precision cooking, while the shopping list generator simplifies grocery shopping by compiling ingredients from chosen recipes. Furthermore, the app's community aspect adds an extra layer of enjoyment. Users can share their own recipes, tips, and tricks, fostering a vibrant culinary community where inspiration knows no bounds. In conclusion, Whisk is more than just a cooking app—it's a culinary companion that empowers users to unleash their inner chef. With its user-friendly interface, vast recipe collection, and interactive features, this app earns a well-deserved five stars. Whether you're a culinary novice or a seasoned chef, Whisk is a must-have tool for anyone passionate about cooking.

title: Very useful
body: Great app, few minor bugs but great functionality and very streamlined.
